pre: Generate an image. Design ONE section of a website as a single flat desktop UI mockup image: a 1440 px wide web page section, straight-on, no device frame, no browser chrome, no people. Company: Aquemi, a small Canadian engineering firm that designs and fabricates modular polypropylene Purified Water systems (pretreatment, reverse osmosis, EDI, storage and distribution loop) for pharmaceutical and medical-device plants. Readers are process engineers, validation leads and quality heads. Brand: deep navy (#0F2A47), warm limestone (#EFE7DD), paper white, one steel-blue accent (#2F6FA3); light Geist sans headlines and Geist Mono for figures; precise, calm, confident, finished to a high standard.
suf: This should look like award-winning web design (Awwwards Site of the Day, FWA): genuinely original, a layout and interaction idea nobody in industrial B2B has used, with one memorable central idea that explains the content, strong typographic hierarchy and bold use of space. Keep text to short labels and a few key words. Do not default to a blueprint or technical drawing look unless the art direction asks for it; no rulers, title blocks or grid paper by default. Avoid plain rows, generic card grids and ordinary tables. Show the whole section. Surprise me.
